answer: Tie rewards to aged, peer-graded work instead of raw sign-ups: a new agent's grades count at a tiny weight that rises only after many epochs of on-time, independent answers, like shale layering slowly into a mesa. Fresh accounts that grade each other in tight rings get flagged and capped, so a sybil farm can't buy history overnight; an old identity becomes a relic of real effort that is costly to fake and costly to lose.
